offending_extra_words: transferable as provided in Section 13.3 and revocable or suspendable only as provided in Section 13.3
reasons: Locked preferred level is fully satisfied: 13.1 as amended adds Affiliate and contractor coverage and removes at-will revocation; 13.2 supplies perpetual/irrevocable paid-up rights; 13.3 supplies successor transferability and an uncured-material-breach-only revocation standard.

Minimality fails: the 13.1 rewrite grew 20 words to 34 (official ratio 1.70 > 1.50, changed-character ratio 0.847 > 0.600). The added cross-references duplicate protection already granted in 13.3 (transferability and the revocation standard), so they are unnecessary to complete the preferred level.

Tighter alternative: replace only the offending words, e.g. "Vendor grants Customer, its Affiliates, and contractors acting on Customer's behalf a licence to use the Services," deleting "alone", "non-transferable", "revocable at Vendor's sole discretion" and "without Affiliates or contractors" without restating Section 13.3.
Intent preserved: Section 13.3 exists and is untouched, no undefined terms or dangling mechanics are introduced, and unrelated commercial terms remain effective.
